Pion WebRTC.header: Pion WebRTC (Go), statistics report returned by PeerConnection.GetStats() on the receiving peer, polled periodically
fields: BytesReceived is the total number of bytes received for this SSRC.
PacketsReceived is the total number of RTP packets received for this SSRC. Kind is either "audio" or "video"
CurrentRoundTripTime represents the latest round trip time measured in seconds,
Jitter is the packet jitter measured in seconds for this SSRC
PacketsLost is the total number of RTP packets lost for this SSRC.
BurstPacketsLost is the cumulative number of RTP packets lost during loss bursts.
HeaderBytesReceived is the total number of RTP header and padding bytes received for this SSRC.

The total number of received DATA packets, including retransmitted packets
Same as [pktRecvTotal](#pktRecvTotal), but expressed in bytes, including payload and all the headers (20 bytes IPv4 + 8 bytes UDP + 16 bytes SRT). Available for receiver.
Smoothed round-trip time (SRTT), an exponentially-weighted moving average (EWMA) of an endpoint's RTT samples, in milliseconds.
